''See also: [[Optasia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Optasia is the Emperor's true [[throne]], located within his private quarters. Physically, it resembles a cage of twisted [[steel]] wires and bars in the shape of a chair. It serves as the central hub for a global network consisting of over three hundred concealed nodes or statues that act as receptors. This system allows the user to magnify and distribute their [[Intent]] across the entire world, enabling them to sense or "[[Read]]" events and buildings from vast distances. Historically, the term referred to primitive devices used for divination or predicting the future, but the modern Optasia was constructed specifically to allow the Emperor to monitor and respond to the [[Great Elders]] from the Capital. While it provides unparalleled global perception, using the device is extremely dangerous; it forces the user to process massive amounts of information and absorb the taint of the [[Elders]], which carries a significant risk of insanity. Due to its immense power, it is typically only [[safe]] for the Emperor, [[Regents]], or a select few [[Guild Heads]] to operate. The device has been a target of conflict, including attempts at sabotage and efforts by groups like the [[Sleepless]] to gain control over it.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Optasia is an ancient relic and controllable device housed within the Emperor's personal quarters, appearing as a flesh-shrouded cage of [[steel]] bars that resembles the [[skeleton]] of a great chair. Serving as an imperial [[throne]], this artifact functions as a global amplification relay that can catch deadly [[Intent]] and transmit it through a network to a thousand relays across the world. A Reader can use the device to enhance perception, allowing them to check for truths or even [[Read]] a building on the opposite side of the planet. Because it is necessary for an Emperor to speak to 'them' and requires specialized preparation to use safely, the [[Elders]] seek to possess it as part of their plan. Although fighting near the device may have caused a [[crack in the sky]], the Optasia sustained no permanent damage and was eventually subject to a request for [[Calder]] to deliver it to [[Kelarac]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Originally a pre-[[Imperial]] divination tool used by primitive men to predict the future or divine danger, the Optasia was later transformed into a global system of 312 concealed nodes. This device serves as the Emperor's true [[throne]] within his personal chambers, functioning to magnify his [[Reading]] to a global [[scale]] by using a network of receptors to channel his power. To operate the system and [[Read]] [[Intent]] from around the world, a user must open themselves to the device and process all the information it collects. While this allows the Emperor to monitor and take action against [[Great Elders]] from a distance, doing so exposes the user to their attention. Although the Emperor has produced hazy bubbles within the device and struggled with its use, the Optasia also possesses the capability to feed a user to [[Kthanikahr]] and has been successfully destroyed.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Optasia is an ancient, world-bending device built into the wall of the [[Emperor's personal rooms|Emperor’s personal chambers]] that resembles a nest of [[steel]] bars and wires. Protected by alchemically treated barbed wire designed to wound and incapacitate intruders, this tool functions as a node within a global network of statues used to amplify [[Reading]] and distribute [[Intent]] throughout the world. While it serves as a means to project consciousness and provides magnification for [[Calder]], the device also acts as his true [[throne]]. During his time in the [[Emperor's personal rooms|Emperor's chambers]], [[Calder]] was able to use the device with Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss's help, though he remained an easy target without its protection. The Optasia eventually caused a [[crack in the sky]] and demonstrated the ability to take over a person when [[Calder]] and the Emperor sank into it.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Yes, the Optasia is in the Emperor’s personal quarters.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“It’s a relic of the Emperor,” Jerri answered, in a tone that suggested he was an idiot. “You sit in it.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“As I understand it, the device will expand your awareness. Thanks to a network of relays, you’ll be able to Read practically anything on the planet from this spot.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“You have to open yourself to it,” Lucan said immediately, “which means Reading everything it picks up.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Yes, and also I can help you use the Optasia.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}
